sources.title: Sevenster, Beckers and Kindt2014
sources.checked: Abstract and primary methods/results/discussion, especially lines95–155 of retrieved page; not every linked source or supplement.
sources.finding: In this human fear-conditioning experiment, reactivation conditions changed whether reconsolidation occurred. Prediction error was not sufficient. These findings do not derive a universal deterministic ArcLoom update law.
sources.limit: No global biological sufficiency theorem or implementation approval inferred.
